sub_graphs.title: EIP-152: BLAKE2 F Precompile Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the execution flow of the BLAKE2 F compression function precompile

nodes.label: Precompile Call Received
nodes.description: CALL to address 0x09 received with input data

nodes.label: Validate Input Length
nodes.description: Check that input is exactly 213 bytes

nodes.label: Input Length Invalid
nodes.description: Input is not 213 bytes, precompile call fails

nodes.label: Parse Input Fields
nodes.description: Extract rounds, h, m, t0, t1, and f from encoded input

nodes.label: Validate Final Block Flag
nodes.description: Check that f byte is exactly 0 or 1

nodes.label: Final Flag Invalid
nodes.description: Final block flag is neither 0 nor 1, precompile fails

nodes.label: Execute BLAKE2 F Compression
nodes.description: Compute BLAKE2 F function as per RFC 7693

nodes.label: Compression Complete
nodes.description: BLAKE2 F compression executed, updated state vector ready

nodes.label: Encode Output State Vector
nodes.description: Encode updated h state vector as 64 bytes little-endian

external_entities.name: Precompile Caller
external_entities.description: Contract or EOA calling the BLAKE2 F precompile

sub_graphs.title: EIP-152: BLAKE2 Input Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the strict input validation rules for the BLAKE2 F precompile

nodes.label: Raw Input Data Received
nodes.description: Byte array received as precompile input

nodes.label: Check Length == 213 Bytes
nodes.description: Enforce exact input length requirement

nodes.label: Extract Rounds Parameter
nodes.description: Read bytes [0:4] as big-endian uint32

nodes.label: Extract State Vector h
nodes.description: Read bytes [4:68] as 8 little-endian uint64 values

nodes.label: Extract Message Block m
nodes.description: Read bytes [68:196] as 16 little-endian uint64 values

nodes.label: Extract Counter Values t
nodes.description: Read bytes [196:212] as 2 little-endian uint64 values

nodes.label: Extract Final Block Flag f
nodes.description: Read byte [212] as boolean indicator

nodes.label: Validate f is Boolean
nodes.description: Check f is exactly 0x00 or 0x01

nodes.label: Input Validation Passed
nodes.description: All validation checks passed, ready for computation

nodes.label: Input Validation Failed
nodes.description: Validation error, precompile returns error

sub_graphs.title: EIP-152: BLAKE2 F Gas Pricing
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation based on rounds parameter

nodes.label: Rounds Parameter Extracted
nodes.description: Number of compression rounds read from input

nodes.label: Compute Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate GFROUND * rounds where GFROUND = 1

nodes.label: Check Gas Available
nodes.description: Verify caller provided sufficient gas for computation

nodes.label: Sufficient Gas Available
nodes.description: Enough gas to complete requested rounds

nodes.label: Insufficient Gas
nodes.description: Not enough gas for requested rounds, call fails

nodes.label: Deduct Gas Cost
nodes.description: Subtract rounds * 1 from available gas

ambiguities.text: The specification uses 'error' for invalid f flag values but does not specify whether this is a revert, out-of-gas, or different error type.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume invalid input causes precompile to return empty output with all gas consumed, consistent with other precompile error behavior.

ambiguities.text: The encoding layout shows '[4][64][128][8][8][1]' but the actual byte boundaries are not explicitly stated.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume consecutive byte layout: rounds[0:4], h[4:68], m[68:196], t0[196:204], t1[204:212], f[212:213].

implicit_assumptions.description: The implementation of BLAKE2 F function matches RFC 7693 exactly without any deviations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent hash outputs could break interoperability with off-chain BLAKE2 implementations.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot craft inputs that cause the BLAKE2 F computation to behave differently than expected.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Potential for precompile to produce incorrect cryptographic outputs enabling signature forgery or hash collisions.

implicit_assumptions.description: GFROUND = 1 provides sufficient gas cost to prevent DoS attacks via excessive rounds.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could specify very high rounds value at low cost, causing CPU exhaustion in validators.
